data.one_liner: Flutter wrapper for Apple Health through HealthKit and Swift Package Manager.
data.what_it_does: Reads, writes, and observes Apple Health data on iOS by wrapping the Swift library HealthKitReporter. Parses all payloads from JSON into typed Dart models.
use_when: You need to read or write Apple Health data in a Flutter iOS application.
You want to observe data changes or handle clinical records and workouts.
avoid_when: Your app targets Android or platforms other than iOS where Apple Health is unavailable.
You want to use CocoaPods instead of Swift Package Manager.
strengths: Comprehensive coverage of HealthKit features including clinical records, workouts, and queries.
Maintains up-to-date parity with the HealthKitReporter Swift library.
weaknesses: iOS only, requiring manual configuration of capabilities, entitlements, and usage descriptions.
Requires Swift Package Manager and iOS 15 or newer.
data.setup_notes: Requires enabling Swift Package Manager in Flutter, setting iOS deployment target to 15.0 or newer, configuring HealthKit capabilities and entitlements in Xcode, and adding usage descriptions to Info.plist.
